description: This file defines the OpenClawChatTransport protocol and related enums and extensions for handling chat transport events, session management, and messaging in the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Requests chat history for a given session key.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with optional attachments.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists chat sessions with an optional limit.

methods.name: setSessionModel
methods.description: Sets the model for a chat session.

methods.name: setSessionThinking
methods.description: Sets the thinking level for a chat session.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns a stream of chat transport events.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the current active session key.
